name: Graph Editor
description: Type an edge list or draw on the canvas — both stay in sync. Drag nodes in Force mode to arrange the layout.
inputPlaceholder:
First line: node count
Following lines: u v [weight]
inputHintIndexed: The first line is the node count. Each following line is an edge: "u v" or "u v weight". A lone index adds an isolated node.
inputHintCustom: Each line is an edge "a b" or "a b weight". A single label on a line adds an isolated node.
skippedLines: {count, plural, one {# line was} other {# lines were}} skipped because they could not be parsed.

modeHint.force: Drag nodes to move and pin them. Click a node to toggle its pinned state.
modeHint.draw: Click empty space to add a node. Click a node, then a second node, to connect them.
modeHint.edit: Click a node to rename it, or click an edge to edit its weight.
modeHint.delete: Click a node to remove it with its edges, or click an edge to remove it.

emptyHint: Type an edge list, or click the canvas in Draw mode to begin.
